This modal can be closed by pressing the Escape key or activating the close button. 6m 31 Mar 2026 Artemis II: NASA’s first manned mission around the moon in 50 years Matt Frei Europe Editor and Presenter Mankind is due to embark on its first mission to the moon since 1972. But unlike Apollo, the Artemis 2 crew includes the first female, Black and non-American astronauts to fly a moon mission. The 10-day flight will see them loop around the moon, though they won’t actually touch down on it. We spoke to NASA’s Head of Science to discuss this historic journey.
